# Test Fixtures

Sample media for tests and for the mock providers, so a full pipeline run needs
no network access (§121, §170).

| Fixture               | Purpose                              | Phase | Origin                                        |
| --------------------- | ------------------------------------ | ----- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `product-sample.jpg`  | Product upload and analysis input    | 4 / 6 | to be generated                               |
| `shot-sample.mp4`     | What the mock video provider returns | 9     | to be generated                               |
| `voice-sample.wav`    | Mock TTS output                      | 12    | to be generated                               |
| `bgm-sample.mp3`      | Background music track               | 12    | must carry an explicit commercial-use licence |
| `subtitle-sample.srt` | Subtitle parsing and burn-in         | 12    | to be generated                               |

**Licensing rule (§121, §32):** fixtures are either generated by this project or
carry a licence permitting use, recorded in the Origin column above. BGM
additionally records `license_type`, `license_source`,
`allowed_commercial_use` and `attribution_required`. Never add media of unknown
provenance.
